'''Anatoly Alexandrovich Alexandrov''' ({{langx|ru|Анато́лий Алекса́ндрович Алекса́ндров}}; born 7 April 1951), {{small|[[Doktor nauk|D.N.]]}}, is a Russian applied physicist and a design engineer who is the [[Rector (academia)|rector]] of the [[Bauman Moscow State Technical University]].<ref>[http://pr.bmstu.ru/?p=3093 Новости ТВ МГТУ]</ref><ref>[http://www.bmstu.ru/news.php?newsid=535 Выборы ректора в МГТУ им. Н. Э. Баумана] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120611083425/http://bmstu.ru/news.php?newsid=535 |date=2012-06-11 }}</ref>

==Biography==
Anatoly Alexandrov graduated from Bauman Moscow State Technical University (MSTU) in 1975.<ref name="тезисы">{{cite web|author=|date=|url=https://bmstu.ru/mstu/elections-2010/alexandrov/|title=О кандидате на место ректора МГТУ|publisher=|access-date=|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111105115047/http://bmstu.ru/mstu/elections-2010/alexandrov/|archive-date=2011-11-05|url-status=live}}</ref> Several years after graduation he worked at MSTU as an engineer. In 1982 was promoted to Design Engineer, then Head of Logistics, then to the position of deputy director of Development and Studies, and later the Chief Engineer of the MSTU Experimental Plant.

Shortly after starting the postgraduate studies (in 1984), he switched to the [[Komsomol]] career and did not complete his [[Candidate of Sciences]] thesis.

In 1991, he was appointed as the Director of  MSTU Experimental Plant. Since 2010 he became a member of the [[Skolkovo innovation center|Skolkovo Foundation]] Council.

In 2004, he was awarded [[Candidate of Sciences]] degree, and two years later —  a [[Doktor nauk]] degree.

In 2010, Anatoly Alexandrov was elected a [[Rector (academia)|Rector]] of MSTU.

In 2022, he signed the [[2022 address of the Russian Union of Rectors|Address of the Russian Union of Rectors]], which called to support [[Vladimir Putin|Putin]] in his [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|invasion of Ukraine]].<ref>[https://rsr-online.ru/news/2022-god/obrashchenie-rossiyskogo-soyuza-rektorov1/ Original text of the Address of the Russian Union of Rectors] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220320105358/https://www.rsr-online.ru/news/2022-god/obrashchenie-rossiyskogo-soyuza-rektorov1/ |date=2022-03-20 }}<br />[https://twitter.com/rvdwalle/status/1500413514384560136/photo/1 English translation of the Address]<br />{{cite news |last=Naujokaitytė |first=Goda |date=2022-03-10 |title=Russian rectors' support for Putin prompts UK universities to cut links |url=https://sciencebusiness.net/news/russian-rectors-support-putin-prompts-uk-universities-cut-links |work=Science. Business |location= |access-date= }}<br />{{cite news |last=Lem |first=Pola |date=2022-03-07 |title=Russian rectors' union echoes Kremlin propaganda on Ukraine |url=https://www.timeshighereducation.com/news/russian-rectors-union-echoes-kremlin-propaganda-ukraine |work=The World University Rankings |location= |access-date= }}<br />{{cite news |last=O’Malley |first=Brendan |date=2022-03-06 |title=Russian Union of Rectors backs Putin's action in Ukraine |url=https://www.universityworldnews.com/post.php?story=20220306120204111 |work=University World News |location= |access-date= }}</ref>

== Accusations of academic fraud ==
The analysis of [[Doctor Nauk]] thesis of Anatoly Alexandrov performed by [[Dissernet]] has demonstrated the presence of plagiarism and other forms of academic fraud.<ref>[http://rosvuz.dissernet.org/person/55307 Analysis of Anatoly Alexandrov's thesis (in Russian)]. rosvuz.dissernet.org</ref>
